source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 7 June 1924, p. 8 ("County council elections: Antrim results"); Irish News, 7 June 1924, p. 8 ("The new councils: Antrim County Council and other results declared")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names, divisions and votes read on the block images of the News-Letter's Antrim results (7 June 1924, p. 8) and checked against the Irish News report of the same date

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1924 and counted at the council boardroom on 6 June. Only three divisions were contested; the News-Letter prints the three contests only, so the uncontested divisions of this district are not listed here. Waring; Aldworth.
